subject.title: fix: stabilize embedded prompt caching across policy and Responses boundaries

question: Should unauthorized turns retain model-visible schemas for computer, cron, gateway, and nodes when immutable turn grants deny execution before hooks and side effects?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes the existing owner-only schema-visibility boundary to gain prompt-cache stability; code review cannot decide that security-presentation and compatibility tradeoff without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve stable visible schemas
options.body: Keep stable protected schemas with immutable grants and hard pre-execution denial after every propagation defect and proof gap is closed.

options.title: Preserve hidden schemas
options.body: Retain owner-only schema visibility and narrow the cache fix so unauthorized turns never receive protected capability definitions.

recommendation.title: Approve stable visible schemas
recommendation.body: Keep stable protected schemas with immutable grants and hard pre-execution denial after every propagation defect and proof gap is closed.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent current-main work most directly owns the immutable MCP grant, revocation, and reconstructed-session boundaries affected by this choice.
